items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: he begged me to come to work with him at Knicks... And we even roomed together. Sharky and I lived together... And we played at Knicks and then we played at the Yacht Club

ctx.x: I got home. What bands did you listen to on records?

Oh, just about all of them. All the local bands, you know. At that time the Rhythm Kings were quite popular when I first started, and Johnny Beisdorfer, and Sharky, a lot of the colored bands I used to listen to. In fact we used to have dance parties at my house, my older brothers had a club and I used to give a dance every so often and hire one of the different bands, Pinky, Pinky Vodakovich at the time, one of the colored bands, different bands you know.
What was the name of the band Pinky was with?
